items.title: Managing General Agents Association publishes guide on closing delegated claims subrogation gap
items.summary: A new guidance paper from the Managing General Agents Association examines how delegated-authority models often leave subrogation recovery rights unassigned.

items.title: UK banks trimming AI risk as market alarm grows, says PRA head
items.summary: UK banks are scaling back artificial intelligence exposure amid growing sector corrections, according to Prudential Regulation Authority head Katharine Braddick.

items.title: Government plans trustee competency framework and mandatory administrator registration
items.summary: The DWP will develop a new trustee competency framework and require pension administrators to register with the Pensions Regulator under proposed reforms.

items.title: Hargreaves Lansdown equity research head Derren Nathan departs
items.summary: Derren Nathan has left his role as head of equity research at Hargreaves Lansdown after more than four and a half years.

items.title: Lemonade Reports Q3 Net Loss of $43.7M Amid 34% Growth in In Force Premium
items.summary: Insurtech Lemonade posted a third-quarter net loss of $43.7 million alongside higher revenue and increased operating expenses driven by marketing investments.

items.title: Pulse Insurance details specialist underwriting approach for complex medical and high-risk cover
items.summary: Lloyd’s Coverholder Pulse Insurance has outlined its specialist underwriting framework for personal accident, high-risk travel, and complex life insurance.
